meta.title: Each vendor's own line savings in the quote view
gaps: The available read-back fields do not expose each vendor's unit price or line savings, so Reference − that vendor's unit price cannot be checked.
The available operations read the pricing round rather than opening a vendor-specific quote view.

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event with two QA vendors invited, each with a submitted bid; bidding still open.
steps: The invited QA vendor reads the pricing round.
A second QA vendor reads the pricing round.
As the invited QA vendor, read the pricing round and check that the read succeeds.
As a second QA vendor, read the pricing round and check that the read succeeds.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: the read succeeds; the read succeeds.
